'None' when it does not say.

item_note_add: VRF-5: an accessory the BoQ says is part of a unit's price (frame / stand, gas charge, drain pump, remote, refnet / Y-joint, MCCB / isolator, AV pads and the like) is answered on the unit item (its includes_* questions), never listed as a separate item, unless the row itself is that item. A central controller described as BACnet / BMS compatible is the 'Touch Screen Central Controller' (the BACnet item only when the row itself is a BACnet integration item). A ducted / ceiling suspended ducted indoor unit is 'Ductable'. An inclusion stated in a heading applies to every unit row under it.
